outputs.name: ivory_enamel_original.png
outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: physically based 3D game asset base-color texture, tileable painted ivory enamel surface.
Primary request: Generate a completely flat, seamless square material texture of warm pale ivory powder-coated enamel for a calm rounded futuristic vending cabinet. This is ONLY a texture swatch; no object, no scene, no perspective, no cast shadows.
Color palette: restrained warm ivory / eggshell, approximately sRGB #e9dfc8, with very gentle fine paint grain, a few delicate tiny cream mottles, extremely subtle hand-painted wear, visually clean at a distance.
Composition: uniform full-frame surface with equal detail density all across, seamlessly repeating left/right and top/bottom.
Lighting: neutral unlit albedo, diffuse flat color, no baked highlights, no directional gradient, no ambient occlusion.
Materials/textures: smooth satin enamel paint, subtle microscopic speckle, low contrast, no large chips or scratches.
Constraints: no text, logos, signs, borders, panels, seams, cracks, shapes, metal exposed, pictorial motifs or watermark. The dominant pale ivory must come from the pixels. A high-quality 1024 x 1024 texture.
outputs.mapping: Light cabinet BODY_VARIANT_WHITE surfaces only; shader/default GLB tint remains white
